displayPattern: Status LED: 2 short flashes then 5 long flashes (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control)
meaning: Invalid model plug / inverter size: the control does not accept the model plug for this inverter.
causes: Model plug not fully engaged on the board
Model plug does not match the inverter size (for example a 2 ton plug on a 3 ton inverter)
diySteps: Technician: install or verify the correct model plug, check it for corrosion or breakage and check its resistance per the wiring diagram
Technician: align the plug per the silkscreen layout; replace the plug or inverter with the correct size, or replace the AOC control if it is damaged
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: this is a configuration fault on the outdoor control board.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
